name: What are the essential steps for maintaining a wooden deck?

mainEntity.name: What are the essential steps for maintaining a wooden deck?

acceptedAnswer.text: Regular cleaning is crucial to prevent mildew and grime buildup. Annually, inspect your deck for loose boards, protruding nails, or signs of rot. Depending on the finish, reapply a sealant or stain every 1-3 years to protect against UV damage and moisture. Address any repairs promptly to prevent minor issues from becoming major problems. Consider professional cleaning and sealing for optimal longevity and appearance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Essential steps include regular cleaning, annual inspections, resealing or restaining every 1-3 years, and prompt repairs.
